content: roadmap.sh: topics markable as done/in-progress/skipped, turning a visual flowchart roadmap into a personal checklist; nodes link out to curated learning resources; progress persists per logged-in user. freeCodeCamp: linear curriculum with lesson-level checkboxes and certification progress bars per module. Both emphasize a big-picture map (roadmap/curriculum tree) plus granular checkbox-level tracking underneath.
